youtube_short.title: Your Home Has a $90K Bill Nobody Warned You About
title_alternatives: The 1% Rule Every Homebuyer Ignores — $90K Mistake
New Homeowners Miss This $4,500 Annual Bill Every Year
youtube_short.description: You ran all the numbers before buying — mortgage, taxes, insurance. But financial experts say you should also budget 1% of your home's value every year just for maintenance. On a $450,000 home, that's $4,500 every single year, and over 20 years it adds up to $90,000. Roof replacements run $8,000–$15,000. A new HVAC system hits $10,000–$12,000. And 64% of homeowners say they were completely blindsided when those bills arrived. The fix: open a separate savings account and auto-transfer $375/month — that's your house's salary. Follow for more money traps most people never see coming. #homebuying #personalfinance #realestate #moneytips #firsttimehomebuyer

hook_line: You forgot a $90,000 bill when you bought your home
